visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shots of hands tearing open fresh donuts to reveal creamy pink and olive-green custard fillings. The crust is golden-brown and dusted with white powdered sugar. The background is a brightly lit, out-of-focus indoor space. Colorful variety text in Traditional Chinese appears at the bottom. (2) Wide shot of the 'TREES BREAD' bakery storefront on an urban sidewalk. The store has a wooden facade and white signs. A male creator with wavy dark hair, wearing a denim jacket over a white t-shirt, stands in front gesturing excitedly. Subtitles and slogans are overlaid on the screen. (3) Inside the brightly lit bakery, a female shop assistant wearing a pink baseball cap and a brown apron waves with both hands from behind a counter filled with packaged bread. The interior has warm wooden shelving. Text overlays show a Japanese greeting. (4) Medium shot of the creator holding a donut in a brown paper wrapper, taking a bite and reacting with enthusiastic facial expressions. He stands inside the bakery near the production area. Yellow subtitles appear below him. (5) Extreme close-ups of the donut's internal custard texture, showing yellow vanilla cream and pink strawberry cream with visible fruit seeds. Hands are seen squeezing the dough to demonstrate its softness. Variety text labels each flavor. (6) A montage of various packaged breads like salted croissants and curry bread on wooden shelves. The creator holds a sausage roll, bites it, and displays the internal cross-section showing a pink sausage. Text explains the taste experience. (7) Final scene showing the creator and the shop assistant waving to the camera from behind the bakery counter. The 'TREES BREAD' logo and additional promotional text with location details are displayed as final overlays.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 日本鳥取 超人氣生甜甜圈. (2) [Slogan]: 來自日本鳥取 的生甜甜圈 Trees Donut 信義安和店. (3) [Subtitle]: 你有吃過嗎? 連店員都是日本人!? (4) [Logo]: こんにちわ. [Slogan]: 歡迎光臨. (5) [Subtitle]: 好可愛喔. 摸的時候就覺得飽滿. 麵包鬆軟 但是非常 有嚼勁. 超級滑順. 真的可以用水潤來形容它. (6) [Variety]: 草莓卡士達生甜甜圈. (7) [Subtitle]: 這個妹仔一定喜歡. 吃起來真的是非常解膩. 它擠出來的內餡~ 而且吃得到草莓果粒. (8) [Variety]: 鐵觀音卡士達生甜甜圈. (9) [Subtitle]: 它那個內餡 我真的要給它滿分. 它完全是 炸開在嘴巴裡面. 吃得到那種悠遠的茶香. 我覺得它可以 用吸的欸. (不是什麼都是用吸的). (10) [Slogan]: Trees Bread 還有其他明星商品. [Variety]: 生吐司 鹽可頌. (11) [Subtitle]: 還有我手上這個 熱狗麵包. 我剛一咬下去 被它腸衣彈到牙齒 (大愛). 有肉汁會噴出來 (更愛). 我一定買10個. 我有機會我就買. (12) [Slogan]: 趕快把這個寶藏小店 分享給你朋友. [Subtitle]: 讓那個日本店員 最好是忙到不想回日本 (想回日本才對吧???). (13) [Subtitle]: 歡迎來鳥取玩~ [Slogan]: 本店 Trees Coffee 在鳥取 鳥取縣鳥取市商榮203-6.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track starts with an upbeat, rhythmic acoustic guitar BGM with a bright, percussive beat. A male narrator begins speaking immediately in Traditional Chinese with high energy, animated pitch contours, and a fast speech rate. A subtle 'pop' SFX is heard as food is torn. (2) A 'ding' bell SFX occurs as the narrator shifts his focus to the store location. The BGM maintains its cheerful major-mode pace. The voice remains highly assertive and positive. (3) A female voice briefly interrupts with a polite, high-pitched Japanese greeting ('Konnichiwa'), followed by the male narrator resuming his fast-paced description. Background ambient noise is minimal. (4) During the food tasting segments, occasional soft crunching or squelch-like SFX are layered to emphasize texture, accompanied by rhythmic 'ding' sounds. The narrator's vocal arousal remains high (level 7). (5) The guitar-led BGM continues steadily through the product descriptions and the call to action at the end. The male voice maintains its clarity and friendly tone until the final greeting, which ends with a smooth audio cut.
